svg.title: Mailslot crate layers
svg.desc: Three frontends sit on top: mailslot-gtk (the mailslot GTK app), mailslot-cli and mailslot-ipc (the mailslotd daemon), plus your own app. All depend downwards on mailslot-core, which has no GTK or UI dependency and is split into modules and six feature flags: server, client, portmap, tls, watch (which implies client) and discovery, all on by default. Below it are the third-party crates each feature pulls in. Animated: each frontend's dependency arrow pulses and all six features light up with their crates; then an app that enables only client lights client and reqwest alone, so it links no axum and has no Engine.
svg.text: library: engine, protocol, server, client; no UI dependency

g.text: mailslot, mailslot-cli and mailslotd build with all six
Your app, client only: the Client API, no Engine, no axum
mailslot, mailslot-cli and mailslotd build with all six
